primary.poolable_reason: THIS PAGE IS CAB_PREP_HIV WITH ONE ADDITIONAL TRIAL THAT DOES NOT BELONG TO IT. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18. Two of the three seeded trials -- NCT02720094 (HPTN 083) and NCT03164564 (HPTN 084) -- ARE THE ENTIRE CONTENT of cab-prep-hiv-auto-full-review, which carries the built pool. The third, NCT02842086 (DISCOVER), randomises F/TAF against F/TDF: BOTH ARMS ARE DAILY ORAL TABLETS. On a page titled for INJECTABLE pre-exposure prophylaxis, neither arm is injectable, so the trial does not answer this page's question at all. No pool is displayed here. primary.the_discover_exclusion_is_not_a_criticis: DISCOVER is a large, well-conducted trial answering a real question -- F/TAF against F/TDF for ORAL pre-exposure prophylaxis. It is excluded because THIS PAGE'S TITLE asks about INJECTABLE prophylaxis and DISCOVER has no injectable arm. The defect is in the topic's trial list, not in the trial.
primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that injectable prophylaxis does or does not work -- that pool exists and is built elsewhere. NOT that DISCOVER is poor. ONLY that this page duplicates another and carries one trial that does not match its own title.
